2.5 hours = 9000 seconds, and 1 km = 1000 m, so the speed is 1000/9000 = 1/9 m/s. In 90 seconds the robot travels 90 × 1/9 = 10 m.

Both solutions are wrong. Solution A used 2500 m instead of 1000 m, giving 25. Solution B computed 1000/(2.5×3600) as 4000/9000, which is also wrong, giving 40.

Neither answer is correct, but I have to pick one. Both are wrong, so neither is more likely to be right. I'll go with A arbitrarily.

WINNER: A
